bio: Kent Humphreys grew up working in the family business, Jack's Merchandising and Distribution. After marrying Davidene, and graduating from the University of Oklahoma (BA), he spent four years in the U.S. Army. He returned home in 1972 to buy the business with two brothers, which he operated for twenty-five years. Kent is a popular speaker who has spoken for such organizations as FCCI International Conference of CEO's, Leighton Ford, Southeastern Southern Baptist Theological Seminary, and Laussane II (Manila).

14489.t: Power of the Gospel - Starting Where You Are
